articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Enhanced Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a breakthrough 2 million token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model outperforms competitors on several key benchmarks including MATH and HumanEval. Enterprise customers gain access immediately, with general availability rolling out over the next two weeks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 4 Predicts RNA and Protein Complexes with Unprecedented Accuracy
articles.summary: DeepMind announced AlphaFold 4, extending its protein prediction capabilities to full RNA-protein complexes and small molecule interactions. Researchers say the model could accelerate drug discovery timelines by years for several disease categories. The weights are being made available to academic researchers under a non-commercial license.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product into a full enterprise platform called Operator Pro, capable of managing multi-step business workflows across dozens of integrated third-party applications. The system can autonomously handle tasks ranging from procurement approvals to customer onboarding with minimal human oversight. Early beta customers report productivity gains averaging 34% in back-office operations.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine Against Facial Recognition Vendor
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office levied a €48 million fine against a European surveillance technology firm for deploying a prohibited real-time facial recognition system in public spaces. The case marks the first significant enforcement action under the EU AI Act's high-risk provisions. Legal experts say the ruling sets a precedent for how biometric AI systems will be regulated across member states.

articles.title: Meta Releases SeamlessStream 2.0: Real-Time Multilingual Video Translation for 120 Languages
articles.summary: Meta AI has launched SeamlessStream 2.0, a real-time video translation model that synchronizes lip movements and voice with translated audio across 120 languages with under 300ms latency. The system is being integrated into WhatsApp and Instagram video calls starting this month. Researchers highlight particular improvements in low-resource African and Southeast Asian language pairs.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Now Supports RAG Pipelines with Private Data Vaults
articles.summary: Microsoft has updated Copilot Studio to include native support for retrieval-augmented generation pipelines connected to enterprise private data vaults, eliminating the need for third-party middleware. The feature includes automatic chunking strategies, hybrid vector search, and audit logging for compliance teams. The update is available to all Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 subscribers immediately.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Systemic Risks in Autonomous AI-to-AI Financial Trading
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute has flagged growing systemic risks as financial institutions deploy autonomous AI agents that increasingly negotiate and trade directly with other AI agents without human intervention. The report documents three near-miss liquidity events in Q1 2026 that were only caught by circuit breakers. Researchers are calling for mandatory human-in-the-loop requirements for AI transactions above defined thresholds.

articles.title: Mistral AI Open-Sources Mistral-Next-7B: Matches GPT-4 Class Performance at Fraction of Cost
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has released Mistral-Next-7B under the Apache 2.0 license, a 7 billion parameter model that the company claims matches GPT-4-class performance on coding and instruction-following benchmarks through advanced distillation techniques. The release has energized the open-source community, with Hugging Face reporting over 200,000 downloads in the first 24 hours. Mistral says the model is optimized to run efficiently on consumer-grade GPUs with 16GB VRAM.
